brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
PepsiCo will invest $1 billion in Colombia over the next five years, the president says. [1]
Colombia arrested the wife and daughter of Ecuador gang boss Fito. [5]

KEY RISKS
Colombia is linked to 358 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, indicating exposure to financial and reputational risks. [E2]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market asks whether the Central Bank of Colombia will make no change to the monetary policy interest rate at the September meeting, priced Yes at 68% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Oct 1, 2026. [E4]

WATCH ITEMS
It is unresolved how Colombia's arrest of Fito's wife and daughter will affect cross-border security dynamics. [5]
